note: vespera_inprocess round 23 fixes: a present but non-Unicode VESPERA_* environment value is now reported by the warn-and-default path instead of silently taking the default; an invalid app name echoes at most 64 bytes of the client value in the 400 message and its tracing detail; the resumable direct write answers an exact-length body over the buffered response cap with the 500 (no Overflow sized past the cap); the strict 422 hoist validates unknown values like the Value walk (a lone surrogate in an unknown key is rejected on both paths); doc corrections for the request-close hook and the serde twins. No change to the wire format.
